title: First Battle of Tabasco
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Battle of Tabasco", at revision 1370618990, opens: "The First Battle of Tabasco was fought during the Mexican–American War, in October 1846, in an attempt to capture cities along the Tabasco coast." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4992419, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1846 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
